The information this plugin provides, like the weather or your next calendar event. Watchfaces, apps and other plugins can show it, if you allow them to.

The things this plugin can do, like turning on a light. Watchfaces, apps, other plugins and Index can ask it to do them; apps need your permission first. What apps have done is listed in Settings › Apps › App activity.

All plugins run locally on your phone and connect directly to each service, they can only use the permissions you allow.
Your complication slots will be replaced with the default readings.

Complications are small pieces of information a watchface shows alongside the time, like the weather, your phone's battery or your next event.

Instead of each watchface asking you to set these up separately, you choose them once here. Every watchface can see this list, and the ones that support it fill their complication slots from it, usually in this order, so put the ones you care about most first.

Watchfaces have to opt in to using this list. Some don't, and will show their own choices or have their own settings instead.
Choose which data you would like watchfaces to display in complication slots, in order

Apps that can't send anything off your phone (no internet access and no phone companion app) can read your data, like your location, calendar or music, without asking, because it can't go anywhere. Apps that could send it off your phone ask first.\n\nEvery app asks before going online, and before acting for you: adding timeline pins, controlling music, launching apps, changing watch settings, ringing your phone, or using a plugin's actions. Every app also asks before reading your notifications.
Apps ask the first time they use any permission, including reading data they couldn't send anywhere.

Apps get any permission they ask for without asking you, including going online, except reading your notifications, which every app still asks for. Anything you've turned off on an app's page stays off. Not recommended!
Whichever you choose, you can review and change each app's permissions on its page. Apps built before permissions existed have their own setting, "Ask before older apps use permissions".
